findings.title: Batch tenant preload collects zero external IDs
findings.failure: HubSpot, Salesforce, and Attio CRM customer syncs (nango-sync-handler → importCustomers) pass tenantExternalIds on contacts; the preloaded map is always empty, so customers import without tenant memberships or are skipped when shouldSkipTenantlessCustomers is true, breaking account–contact linking in production.
findings.fix: Build the ID list from records that have non-empty tenantExternalIds (e.g. inRecords.filter with length > 0), not from recordsWithTenantStubs; add or run importCustomers.tenants.litest batch/membership cases before merge.
findings.evidence: recordsWithTenantStubs is defined as tenantExternalIds undefined or length === 0 (lines 485-487), then flatMap(r => r.tenantExternalIds ?? []) on that set is always []. importCustomer only resolves tenants via tenantsByExternalId.get (327-331). Mappers set tenantExternalIds in packages/importers/src/adapters/{hubspot,salesforce,attio}/mappers/toCustomer.ts; handleImportSyncMessage calls importCustomers.

findings.title: importCustomer drops per-record tenant lookup when map omitted
findings.failure: Callers that invoke importCustomer without tenantsByExternalId (importThreads.ts:140, importThreadMessage.ts:150, importAllCustomersAndUsersInRecords.ts:59) now use an empty Map instead of getTenantsFromIdentifiers; any record with tenantExternalIds never links to tenants and never fails on lookup error.
findings.fix: When args.tenantsByExternalId is undefined, keep the HEAD~1 behaviour: call tenantAggregate.getTenantsFromIdentifiers for that record’s IDs and fail on lookupResult.isErr; use the map only when the batch caller preloaded it.
findings.evidence: Diff removes lookupResult and scope.fail; replacement is args.tenantsByExternalId ?? new Map() plus flatMap from map only. PR summary claims single-customer callers keep per-customer lookup but code does not. Grep importCustomer(ctx shows only batch passes tenantsByExternalId (line 539).

findings.title: Chunk tenant lookup errors swallowed
findings.failure: A failed getTenantsFromIdentifiers for one chunk logs warn and continues; affected external IDs are treated as missing tenants. Previously each customer import failed the whole record on lookup error, so partial DB/permission failures can silently drop tenant links or trigger incorrect skip paths.
findings.fix: Return Result.err on first chunk failure (restore fail-fast) or fail the batch import; do not return Result.ok with a partial map unless product explicitly accepts best-effort linking.
findings.evidence: HEAD~1 importCustomer returned scope.fail on lookupResult.isErr (diff removed). getTenantsByExternalId only ever returns Result.ok(tenantsByExternalId) after continue on isErr.

findings.title: NOOP fast path ignores importedByJobDefinitionId
findings.failure: CRM import passes onUpdate: {} and importedByJobDefinitionId on every upsertCustomer. When field data is unchanged, the new fast path calls shouldPerformCustomerUpsertUpdate(customer, onUpdate) without the third argument; a customer whose importedByJobDefinitionId should be stamped on re-sync stays stale (NOOP) whereas the transactional path would write UPDATED.
findings.fix: Pass importedByJobDefinitionId into shouldPerformCustomerUpsertUpdate on the fast path, matching updateCustomerUnsafe; only return NOOP without a transaction when that helper returns false with the same arguments as the full path.
findings.evidence: shouldPerformCustomerUpsertUpdate returns true when importedByJobDefinitionId differs from customer.importedByJobDefinitionId (packages/aggregates/src/utils/shouldPerformCustomerUpsertUpdate.ts:16-21). parseImportCustomer sets onUpdate: {} (importCustomers.ts:240). Fast path omits third param; transactional NOOP check includes importedByJobDefinitionId (customerAggregate.ts:1025-1033).

findings.title: Unreachable isErr branch after batch tenant preload
findings.failure: No runtime effect today, but the branch documents false guarantees and hides the swallowed-chunk behaviour; reviewers may assume batch aborts on lookup failure.
findings.fix: Remove the dead branch or make getTenantsByExternalId return Result.err when any chunk fails.
findings.evidence: getTenantsByExternalId has no Result.err return path (lines 277-290). Repo search: only return Result.ok in that function.

findings.title: Align importCustomer with documented batch vs single lookup split
findings.failure: N/A (design); current shape caused the empty-map and wrong-record-set bugs.
findings.fix: Use tenantsByExternalId only when provided; otherwise inline the former getTenantsFromIdentifiers block. In importCustomers, compute tenantExternalIdsForBatch from records with non-empty tenantExternalIds once, call getTenantsByExternalId, pass map to every importCustomer in the loop.
findings.evidence: Comment at importCustomers.ts:531 says tenantExternalIds handled internally but lookup moved to batch; batch input uses wrong filter (485-512). PR summary describes fallback that importCustomer does not implement.

findings.title: NOOP upsert without transaction retains existing race window
findings.failure: Concurrent writers can still interleave; unchanged upserts now skip withTransaction entirely, so a concurrent field update between the read and a peer NOOP is the same class of lost update as before (selectForUpdate was already false in the transactional path).
findings.fix: No change required if accepting existing upsertCustomer race tradeoff; monitor CRM duplicate/conflict metrics after deploy.
findings.evidence: Existing comment on selectForUpdate: false and race conditions (lines 670-672). Fast path adds a non-locking read before optional skip.

checked_fine: Deploy: diff touches only packages/aggregates and packages/importers; no OpenTofu/SST, migrations, env vars, IAM, or CloudFormation exports.
Contract: upsertCustomer still returns CREATED | UPDATED | NOOP; GraphQL and import recorder mapping unchanged; no event or stored schema field changes.
Data: no deletes, retention, or irreversible migrations; rollback to HEAD~1 is code-only (memberships not auto-repaired if wrong data shipped).

CRM onUpdate path: parseImportCustomer leaves onUpdate empty and does not set email/companyId on update, so email/company resolution still uses the full transactional upsert path when those fields appear on onUpdate.
Embedded-tenant import path: records without tenantExternalIds still use importTenants + preSyncedTenants; unchanged aside from shared importCustomer upsert behaviour.
Blast radius: upsertCustomer fast path gated on onUpdate.email === undefined && onUpdate.companyId === undefined; Slack-style upserts that include companyId in onUpdate bypass the fast path.
Operability: TENANT_LOOKUP_CHUNK_SIZE 500 matches chunked aggregate lookup pattern; uniq on tenantExternalIds dedupes batch IDs correctly once the source record set is fixed.
Tests: new litest coverage for NOOP transaction count and intended single batch external-id lookup (validates intent once batch ID collection is fixed).
